text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "hiking a 12-mile trail"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 4, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "walk the first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 1, "unit": "hour", "kind": "count", "span": "took 1 hour to walk the first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 2, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "walk the next two miles"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 1, "unit": "hour", "kind": "count", "span": "another hour to walk the next two miles"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 4, "unit": "miles per hour", "kind": "count", "span": "average speed to be 4 miles per hour"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q2", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "miles covered in the first two legs"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q3", "q5"], "out": "s2", "note": "hours elapsed so far"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s3", "note": "remaining miles of the trail"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "q6"], "out": "s4", "note": "total time needed to finish the whole trail at the target average speed"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s4", "s2"], "out": "s5", "note": "time remaining to cover the rest of the trail"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s3", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "remaining miles divided by remaining time = required speed"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the speed (miles per hour) she needs for the remaining distance"}, "dismissed": []}
